main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move, signed for the short, before costs

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases grouped by day

main_measure.threshold: positive with t >= 2 to confirm; negative with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean unusual move (split at raw lift median)

decided_by: The t of the mean unusual move lies between -2 and 2. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.276 (below 1), 104 cases (30 needed).
reading: Situation = recorded raw lift (recomputed from prices if missing) >= 2.0 on bars where the regime detector chose mean_reversion (its vetoes are the falling-calm profile, whose 60- and 365-bar inputs cannot be rebuilt inside a window), expected side short; cases = every bar with forecast < 0 that has a next bar in its window; drift = coin's mean 1-bar return over all its windows; t clusters deviations by UTC day; supporting split: upper = raw lift strictly above the cases' median, lower = at or below.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.276 (below 1), 104 cases (30 needed)
